meta.name: linkedin-ads-optimization
meta.description: Troubleshoot and optimize LinkedIn Ads campaigns for better performance. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn ads not working, low CTR, high CPL, creative fatigue, LinkedIn ads troubleshooting, campaign optimization, LinkedIn ads performance issues, or competitive research. Triggers on "LinkedIn ads not working", "low CTR", "high CPL", "creative fatigue", "optimize LinkedIn ads", "troubleshoot LinkedIn", "ads underperforming", "competitive research", "LinkedIn Ads Library". Do NOT use for initial campaign setup (use campaign-setup) or audience building (use audiences).

copy.tagline: 优化 LinkedIn 广告表现，提升点击率并降低转化成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在为 LinkedIn 广告的低效和高成本烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Optimize LinkedIn ads for better CTR and lower CPL
copy.fit_line_en: For you if struggling with LinkedIn ad inefficiency and high costs

howto.what: Claude会系统诊断LinkedIn广告效果问题（如低点击率、高成本），按检查清单找出原因并给出具体修复建议，同时可借助ColdIQ平台获取竞争广告情报。
howto.when: 当用户提到广告不工作、低点击率、高单次转化成本等LinkedIn广告效果问题时触发。

say.text: 我的LinkedIn广告点击率很低，怎么优化？
say.note: Claude会按诊断清单逐一排查并给出修复步骤。

say.text: 如何查看竞争对手在LinkedIn上的广告？
广告创意疲劳了，该怎么做？
say.note: Claude会建议刷新频率和轮换格式。

howto.what_en: Claude systematically diagnoses LinkedIn Ads performance issues (e.g., low CTR, high CPL) using a checklist, identifies root causes, and provides targeted fixes. It can also pull competitive ad research via ColdIQ.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions ads not working, low CTR, high CPL, creative fatigue, or other LinkedIn Ads performance issues.

say_en.text: My LinkedIn Ads CTR is low, how to optimize?
say_en.note: Claude runs diagnostic checklist and provides fixes.

say_en.text: How to see what competitors are doing on LinkedIn?
say_en.note: Claude guides through Ads Library or ColdIQ research.

say_en.text: Creative fatigue, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude suggests refresh frequency and format rotation.
